Services, The Mother and Child Benefit Programme (MCBP) MIS is a web-based Management Information System designed to manage, monitor, and report all operational activities of the MCBP under the Department of Women Affairs, Ministry of Women and Children Affairs. The system supports end-to-end beneficiary lifecycle management including application, selection, approval, enrollment, payment processing, monitoring, and exit tracking. It maintains a centralized beneficiary database with detailed demographic, socio-economic, and payment information to ensure transparency and accountability. MCBP MIS enables real-time data entry and access from upazila, district, and central levels, ensuring coordinated implementation across administrative tiers. It generates automated reports on active beneficiaries, new enrollment, exits, fund disbursement, and financial utilization to support decision-making. The system facilitates digital payment integration, through G2P, to ensure timely and accurate transfer of benefits to eligible mothers. It also supports grievance tracking, monitoring dashboards, and audit trails to enhance governance and reduce duplication or irregularities. The MIS is designed with scalability and interoperability features, enabling future expansion of beneficiary coverage and integration with national ID, payment gateways, and other government social protection systems. Overall, MCBP MIS plays a critical role in improving service delivery, data accuracy, monitoring efficiency, and evidence-based policy planning for maternal and child social protection interventions in Bangladesh.
